title: Summary clock correctness
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine over bits with state set $Q$, let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, and let $t$ be a natural number. Starting the summary clock at $c$ with the summary of its current output gives true exactly when the configuration reached after $t$ steps is halted and the summary of its output is true.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ is a natural number of work tapes
$M$ is a multi-tape Turing machine over bits with state set $Q$
